packs.name: The Whole Cutlery Drawer
packs.tagline: Every fork, spoon and spork in the Market, in one click.
packs.summary: Installs every package this device can install, so nothing is missing. Local AI models (multi-gigabyte downloads) and skins are left out; install those on their own.

packs.name: Chat & Essentials
packs.tagline: Talk to your team and keep the basics close.
packs.summary: Chat and Inbox for conversations, Agents for your AI helpers, and Notes, Tasks, Calendar and Timers to keep the day organised.

packs.name: Site Mover
packs.tagline: Everything you need to run a website's repository on ForkMesh.
packs.summary: Code, Commits, Branches and Pull requests for the repository, Issues for the to-do list, Actions and Workflows for builds and deploys, Releases for shipped versions, and Status Page to watch the live site.
